geometry._help: Angles in degrees, one value per leg (leg i is driven by motors[i]). alpha1: ring axis(-z) -> middle joint axis. alpha2: middle joint axis -> head joint axis. beta: effector axis -> head joint axis. eta: azimuth of each head joint around the effector axis. branch: +1/-1 elbow direction of each leg (flip if the 3D view doesn't match the CAD at home).

mount._help: How the SPM base sits on the pelvis. The ring axis (base -> head) points laterally, tipped down by tilt_down_deg and swung forward by forward_deg. base_twist_deg spins the base about its own axis.

neutral._help: Effector orientation (in the base frame) that corresponds to anatomical neutral, as small rotations from the symmetric home.

limits._help: Safety gate. Poses failing any check are refused and the last safe pose is held. Tune min_ring_separation_deg and max_tilt_deg from the CAD (link collisions are NOT modelled otherwise).

imu._help: Femur IMU board over USB. trim_gain (1/s) > 0 closes an outer loop on the IMU-measured TILT error (0 = monitor only). trim_limit_deg caps the correction.
